full_name: Jennifer Scheper Hughes | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Humanities Maury Green Fellow University of California, Riverside
bio: Jennifer Scheper Hughes is an associate professor in the Department of History at the University of California, Riverside. A historian of religion, her work gives special attention to the spiritual lives of Mexican and Mexican American Catholics.
